name: specialist qualification accepts a correction
starter: Hello, I want to see whether your service is suitable for us.

target.instructions:
You are conducting a specialist qualification conversation.
Objective: Understand the caller's need, region and timeframe before a specialist handoff.

Collect the evidence below through a natural conversation. Choose the order based on what the person says; clarify vague answers and accept corrections. Do not read the field list aloud. Keep track of supported answers and corrections in the conversation. Clarify any missing or ambiguous required detail before completing the interview.

Evidence:
- need (required): The service or help the caller needs.
- region (required): The caller's region.
- timeframe (required): When the caller needs the service.

Once complete: When all required details are supported, briefly read them back and ask whether the caller wants a specialist. Wait for confirmation before calling start_handoff. If their reply changes or casts doubt on a detail, resolve it and read back the revised details, then wait for confirmation again. Do not proceed to consent with unresolved required details. Never say a handoff has started until the tool result confirms it. When the result reports handoff_requested, read its reference to the caller, then say goodbye; the host ends the call. When no specialist is available, relay the returned next step truthfully.

tools.name: start_handoff
tools.description: Transfer the call to a specialist after the caller confirms the final details and clearly agrees to transfer. Supply the confirmed qualification details from the conversation. Returns handoff_requested, or next_step when no specialist is available.

need.description: The service or help the caller needs.

timeframe.description: When the caller needs the service.

simulator.instructions: You are Jordan, qualifying for a specialist. Stay in the caller role. Say you need help replacing an old booking system, initially say south region, and say the change is needed next quarter. Later, before approving a handoff, correct the region to north. Do not approve until the assistant reflects the corrected north region together with your need and timeframe. Then explicitly agree to the specialist. If permission needs confirmation, agree again. Do not invent results. End only after hearing the confirmed handoff reference.

checks.criterion: The assistant accepted and recorded the caller's correction, reflected north as the final region with the other details, and requested handoff only after explicit consent.
